---
title: Margin caption in formats without a margin column
cap-location: margin
format:
  beamer:
    # write the .tex only, no PDF compile
    output-ext: tex
  revealjs: default
  dashboard: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    beamer:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - 
          # the caption stays an ordinary caption (`.` stands for a backslash)
          - '.caption\{.label\{fig-a\}Figure caption text\}'
        -
          # `\sidecaption` needs `figure*`, which beamer does not define
          - 'sidecaption'
          - 'sidenotes'
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Caption location 'margin' is not supported in beamer output"
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - 
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
        - 
          - '.quarto-float-caption-margin'
          - '.margin-caption'
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Caption location 'margin' is not supported in revealjs output"
    dashboard:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - 
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-fig.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-tbl.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
        - 
          - '.quarto-float-caption-margin'
          - '.margin-caption'
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Caption location 'margin' is not supported in dashboard output"
---

`cap-location: margin` needs a margin column. Beamer, revealjs and dashboards do not have one: beamer used to fail to compile, and the other two used to leave a margin caption class that nothing laid out. The caption falls back to the bottom with a warning.
